item.aggregated_output:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

item.text: The API documentation confirms paginated orders and per-customer discount records. I hit a local tooling mismatch on the first probe, so I’m switching to a retry-aware client that will refresh expired tokens, honor server-provided rate-limit delays, and cache customers.

The complete listing covered 30 pages: 1,480 distinct listings, with 20 repeated order IDs removed. I’ve calculated 407 qualifying shipped orders and am now validating the requested file shape and sums before the one-time procedural close.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('result.json','utf8')); const keys=Object.keys(x).sort().join(','); const regions=Object.keys(x.by_region).sort().join(','); const sum=Object.values(x.by_region).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); if(keys "'!== '"'by_region,duplicates_skipped,order_count,total_cents'||regions "'!== '"'east,north,south,west'||sum "'!== x.total_cents||!Number.isInteger(x.total_cents)||!Number.isInteger(x.order_count)||!Number.isInteger(x.duplicates_skipped)||!Object.values(x.by_region).every(Number.isInteger)) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({valid:true,total_cents:x.total_cents,regions_sum:sum,keys,regions}));"'
